verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user-definable event-to-action rules engine in Google Workspace. Apps Script is described only as a way to 'automate Admin console tasks', with no mention of event triggers. Automatic user provisioning sync, dynamic groups, Context-Aware Access policies and alerts are adjacent features or fixed behaviors, not user-defined rules that fire actions on events, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
